statistical_prescription: Primary Gaussian: arithmetic mean of upper and lower statistical errors, quadrature systematic and model errors. Sensitivity: split Gaussian with upper error for prediction above central value and lower otherwise.
covariance: No published covariance; all bins and systematic/model errors treated as diagonal. Independent of other measurement blocks.
bin_prescription: Evaluate at published efficiency-corrected average virtualities; broad-bin unfolding is source-model dependent, covered only by published model errors.
upper_limit_prescription: Sensitivity replaces central measurements in bins 2 and 5 by normalized Gaussian censoring deviance at the published 90 percent upper limits, with sigma=UL/1.2815515655446004. This is an assumed surrogate, not the published Poisson likelihood; central values and limits never counted together.
